entries.body: Per-team league record and ranking inputs.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Per-team league record and ranking inputs.

entries.body: League positions and cutoff labels.
entries.formula: Configured league cutoffs; positions are read from config/competitions.yaml, not recomputed from results.
limitations: Cutoff positions are configured; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: League positions and cutoff labels.

entries.body: Competition identity, coverage and match counts.
entries.formula: One row per configured competition; counts are fixtures or table rows joined by competition_id; coverage states come from the source frame.
limitations: Competition metadata and coverage; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Competition identity, coverage and match counts.

entries.body: League Cup groups, rounds, ties and qualifiers.
entries.formula: Group tables: points = 3*won + drawn + shootout bonus; ties and rounds counted from cup fixtures; qualifiers read from config/cups.yaml.
limitations: Cup structure and results; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: League Cup groups, rounds, ties and qualifiers.

entries.body: Scottish Cup rounds, ties and coverage.
entries.formula: Rounds and ties counted from cup fixtures; coverage compares published ties with the configured official round count.
limitations: Cup structure and results; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Scottish Cup rounds, ties and coverage.

entries.body: Recent and split form for both teams.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Recent and split form for both teams.

entries.body: League strength, percentiles and comparison.
entries.formula: ppp = points/played; ppg = points/played; gf_pg = gf/played; ga_pg = ga/played; gd_pg = (gf-ga)/played; shots_for_pm = shots/matches; shot_share = team shots/(team + opponent shots); rank = 1 + count of better teams (lower is better for ga_pg); league_size = teams in the league; position_gap and ppg_gap = team value minus opponent value. Percentiles set the bar length; ranks set the visible label.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: League strength, percentiles and comparison.

entries.body: Shot profile, approach index and style lean.
entries.formula: Approach index is the mean of within-league percentiles for shots, shots on target, goals and corners; possession is not used. Style lean is the sign of the approach index against the league median.
limitations: Shot-profile derivatives; provenance checked, not independently recomputed.
entries.short: Shot profile, approach index and style lean.

entries.body: Predicted lineups, scores, selection weights and availability.
entries.formula: Player score = 0.20*form + 0.10*minute_share + 0.15*recent_rating + 0.15*role_fit + 0.18*recency_start + 0.22*start_rate. Availability counts curated entries; opponent availability is not modelled.
limitations: Selection and formation projections; provenance checked, not recomputed. The opponent rating is only present when /fixtures/players returns one.
entries.short: Predicted lineups, scores, selection weights and availability.

entries.body: Snapshot, lineup and form coverage.
entries.formula: age_hours = (generated_at - snapshot_at)/3600; lineup_coverage = fixtures_with_lineups/fixtures; counts are from the opponent snapshot.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Snapshot, lineup and form coverage.

entries.body: Recent meetings and results.
entries.formula: League meetings joined by date and team ids; result is W/D/L for Aberdeen; score is the final score, with shootouts shown separately.
limitations: Historical meeting snapshot; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Recent meetings and results.

entries.body: Upcoming club fixtures.
entries.formula: Upcoming competitive club fixtures from the merged season schedule, ordered by local date and kickoff; current plus the next five are rendered on matchday. Conflict-review and friendly rows are excluded from the lookahead.
limitations: Fixture snapshot; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Upcoming club fixtures.

entries.body: Family counts and availability summary.

formula.availability_known: count squad players with availability.status != unknown

limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Family counts and availability summary.

entries.body: Per-family depth, quality, availability, market and roster metrics.
entries.formula: measured_score = 100 * sum(w*x)/sum(w) over available drivers: depth_gap 0.30, quality_gap 0.20, top_share 0.10, availability_risk 0.25, age_risk 0.15. availability_risk = (out + 0.5*doubtful)/known projected players; null when known = 0.
limitations: Derived family metrics; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Per-family depth, quality, availability, market and roster metrics.

entries.body: Roster current/max and outgoing-first policy.
entries.formula: roster current = senior squad players under contract; max from config/needs.yaml; outgoing-first policy is a config flag, not a measured value.
limitations: Roster policy; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Roster current/max and outgoing-first policy.

entries.body: Needs coverage and availability status.
entries.formula: Counts of known and unknown availability entries, contract data and squad rows; states are available, partial or unavailable.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Needs coverage and availability status.

entries.body: Register totals, players and period.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Register totals, players and period.

entries.body: Per-window arrival/departure and valuation counts.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Per-window arrival/departure and valuation counts.

entries.body: Per-move fee, loan and verification values.
entries.formula: One row per confirmed move; fee is disclosed/reported/inferred/undisclosed; inferred ranges are modelled, never treated as fees; loan terms are unknown unless confirmed.
limitations: Per-row curated fees and terms; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Per-move fee, loan and verification values.

entries.body: Modelled fee ranges and calibration counts.
entries.formula: Fee range from disclosed comparables by position, age and league; calibration counts are the rows with a disclosed or reported anchor used to fit the range.
limitations: Modelled valuation; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Modelled fee ranges and calibration counts.

entries.body: Sell-on percentages, basis and summary.
entries.formula: Sell-on percentage is published only where confirmed; summary counts confirmed, reported and unknown clauses; unknown is not zero.
limitations: Curated sell-on clauses; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Sell-on percentages, basis and summary.

entries.body: Loan-in and loan-out slices.
entries.formula: Loan-in and loan-out rows from the confirmed register; one row per loan; parent club, dates and terms are source-linked.
limitations: Loan rows; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Loan-in and loan-out slices.

entries.body: Withheld suspect rows and plausibility counts.
entries.formula: Counts of rows withheld or flagged by the plausibility audit; the audit compares fee, age, position and window against the published register.
limitations: Plausibility policy; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Withheld suspect rows and plausibility counts.

entries.body: Seniority review, position coverage and gap ledger counts.
entries.formula: Counts by seniority, position coverage and gap status; the ledger records unresolved or duplicate identities, not transfer claims.
limitations: Completeness audit is report-only; it does not prove provider completeness.
entries.short: Seniority review, position coverage and gap ledger counts.

entries.body: Audited/curated window coverage.
entries.formula: Windows are audited or curated partial; counts are confirmed rows per window; earlier windows are partial, not silently complete.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Audited/curated window coverage.

entries.body: Era aggregates: seasons, managers, honours and positions.
entries.formula: seasons = covered seasons; best/worst_position = min/max league position; average_position = mean season position; average_points = mean season points; manager_count = distinct people with a league match; honours_total = register count.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Era aggregates: seasons, managers, honours and positions.

entries.body: Season-level history rows.
entries.formula: One row per season; league position/points from the club payload; cup and European outcomes from season documents; manager spells kept separate.
limitations: Curated season refs; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Season-level history rows.

entries.body: Manager/staff stints and records.
entries.formula: One row per manager or staff stint; played, points, gf and ga are league matches only; interim spells are separate.
limitations: Curated staff stints; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Manager/staff stints and records.

entries.body: League-only baseline window.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: League-only baseline window.

entries.body: History season/backfill coverage.
entries.formula: Counts of seasons with history documents, backfilled lineups, staff and honours; missing seasons are labelled unavailable.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: History season/backfill coverage.

entries.body: Per-season history documents.
entries.formula: Document envelope: one per season with review, style, selection, staff, transfers and honours; measured facts and the labelled assessment are kept separate.
limitations: Curated season documents; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Per-season history documents.

entries.body: Squad size, official-roster reconciliation, loans, role evidence and coverage counts.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Squad size, official-roster reconciliation, loans, role evidence and coverage counts.

entries.body: Official team-list loans, current-register loans and all-time register loans, with the reconciliation between them.
entries.formula: official_list counts status loan_out in the official squad rows; register_current counts confirmed loan rows for the current season; register_all_time counts every confirmed loan row. The three are published separately and never substituted for one another.
limitations: The official team list and the transfer register are different scopes; both counts are shown.
entries.short: Official team-list loans, current-register loans and all-time register loans, with the reconciliation between them.

entries.body: Per-player totals, playing time, role, position and official-roster reconciliation fields.
entries.formula: Playing time reconstructed from lineups and substitution events; starts and minutes are competitive-only; role shares use starting-XI observations; totals sum competition rows.
limitations: Per-player rows; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Per-player totals, playing time, role, position and official-roster reconciliation fields.

entries.body: Role/career/position/attribute coverage metadata.
entries.formula: Coverage flags for role, career, position and attribute data; unknown fields are null, not filled.
limitations: Coverage metadata; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Role/career/position/attribute coverage metadata.

entries.body: Per-player page panels, two-figure Nightingale rose, availability projection and recent match log.
entries.formula: Document envelope: player totals, playing time, role evidence, position stats, the published rose axes, the curated availability projection and the latest competitive match rows for one player. The rose uses league-only rates from the provider season totals; each percentile is the midrank rank of the raw value in the player's league and role cohort (provider-group fallback), with conceded_p90 ranked on negated values. The percentile is null when the cohort or value is unavailable. Where current-season Premiership minutes are below the squad threshold, the rose uses the most recent prior Premiership season with at least 180 league minutes and a same-season cohort; season_used, cohort_season, fallback and fallback_note are published and visible. The summary minutes remain current-season. The match log is a projection of the normalized player-match rows joined to the fixture date, opponent and score; it is not recomputed in React.
limitations: Player page rows; provenance checked, not recomputed.
The provider rating is opaque and league-relative; it is not a verdict.
Rose percentiles are within one league and role cohort; there is no cross-league ranking.
Availability is the curated ledger projection, not an inferred injury.
The recent match log is limited to the latest 10 competitive current-season rows with provider coverage; missing values are a dash.
entries.short: Per-player page panels, two-figure Nightingale rose, availability projection and recent match log.

entries.body: Curated rumour counts and status.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Curated rumour counts and status.

entries.body: Advisory recruitment profile weights and buckets.
entries.formula: Advisory profile from active incoming external_target rows only; current squad, current non-official and former players are excluded, and return links are listed separately. Buckets are descriptive, not probabilities or recommendations.
limitations: Advisory profile; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Advisory recruitment profile weights and buckets.

entries.body: Fan-signal coverage, sentiment and profile.
entries.formula: Mention counts from sampled first pages; each name is labelled by canonical affiliation; the position and age profile counts external_target only; topic-level VADER sentiment only; no per-player sentiment score is published.
limitations: Reference fan signal; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Fan-signal coverage, sentiment and profile.

entries.body: Layer/source row counts and truth table.
entries.formula: Row counts by source layer; status is the source probe state; coverage gaps remain visible in the truth table.
limitations: Provenance summary; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Layer/source row counts and truth table.

entries.body: Build coverage counts across surfaces.
entries.formula: Counts of built pages and published payloads per surface; used by the build status page.
limitations: Registered family; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Build coverage counts across surfaces.

entries.body: Configured former-player universe, rival list, development proxy and sell-on policy.
entries.formula: Read from config/former_players.yaml; the universe is the latest published permanent/free departure, excluding current squad, returns and loan-outs.
limitations: The register covers 2019-20 onward; earlier departures are outside the record.
A definition is a policy, not a claim that every departure is captured.
entries.short: Configured former-player universe, rival list, development proxy and sell-on policy.

entries.body: Former-player counts by departure, destination, current status, rival spell and coverage.
entries.formula: One row per canonical former player; buckets count those rows; a missing value is unknown, never zero.
limitations: A later career is context, not proof that a sale was right or a fee was good.
entries.short: Former-player counts by departure, destination, current status, rival spell and coverage.

entries.body: One row per canonical former player with departure, Aberdeen record, post-career summary and sell-on reference.
entries.formula: The universe rule, then one Aberdeen tenure aggregation and one post-career league aggregation per player. Provider ratings stay league-relative.
limitations: Post-career ratings are provider values and are not comparable across leagues.
A player without an API id has no measured post-career record.
entries.short: One row per canonical former player with departure, Aberdeen record, post-career summary and sell-on reference.

entries.body: League season rows and per-season rates after the Aberdeen departure.
entries.formula: League-only provider seasons after departure; per-90 rates only above the configured minutes gate; no cross-league percentile.
limitations: Cup and European provider rows are stored locally but excluded because some repeat league totals.
The provider does not cover every league.
entries.short: League season rows and per-season rates after the Aberdeen departure.

entries.body: Sell-on clause event, receipt and missing-input state.
entries.formula: Detect the first permanent/free move away from the buyer; compute a receipt only when percentage, basis and every required public fee are evidenced; otherwise return the missing inputs.
limitations: Instalments, add-ons, agent fees and solidarity terms are unknown.
A receipt is an implied gross share before deductions, not confirmed cash.
entries.short: Sell-on clause event, receipt and missing-input state.

entries.body: Descriptive exit cohorts and post-Aberdeen distributions.
entries.formula: Counts and distributions over the canonical former players; young exits at the configured age, developed proxy at the configured debut age and starts; no composite score.
limitations: The counterfactual is unobservable; later success does not prove a sale was wrong.
The developed proxy is not an academy register.
entries.short: Descriptive exit cohorts and post-Aberdeen distributions.

entries.body: Backfill counts, gaps and current-club coverage.
entries.formula: Expected player-seasons from departure to current; present league seasons; gaps and provider budget from the local backfill meta.
limitations: Provider coverage varies by league and season.
entries.short: Backfill counts, gaps and current-club coverage.

entries.body: Former-player mention lane and external-target profile counts.
entries.formula: Signals are labelled by affiliation from the current squad and former register; position and age mixes count external_target only; the former lane is a filtered view of the same signal rows.
limitations: Sampled first pages only; a mention is not a target or a probability.
entries.short: Former-player mention lane and external-target profile counts.

entries.body: Curated rumours whose subject is a former player.
entries.formula: Rows whose canonical affiliation is former_player; a return link is a former player named as an incoming target and is shown separately.
limitations: The curated register is currently empty until a sourced row is added.
entries.short: Curated rumours whose subject is a former player.

entries.body: Pass/fail counts for the published cross-surface consistency checks, including the former-player, result/form, semantic, epoch and manifest checks.
entries.formula: One record per named consistency check; passed + failed = checks.
limitations: Generated from the same published corpus; it catches disagreement, not an incorrect shared formula.
entries.short: Pass/fail counts for the published cross-surface consistency checks, including the former-player, result/form, semantic, epoch and manifest checks.

entries.body: Dataset, availability and per-source freshness states exposed to the client.
entries.formula: Read from config/matchday.yaml stale_after_hours, config/availability.yaml policy.max_age_days and the former-player refresh timestamp.
limitations: Config-backed thresholds plus measured source ages; not a quality verdict.
entries.short: Dataset, availability and per-source freshness states exposed to the client.

entries.body: Aberdeen club summary, history and news rows.
entries.formula: Club summary joins league table, recent results, upcoming fixtures and news metadata by club id; no commercial or attendance series is invented.
limitations: Club summary payload; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Aberdeen club summary, history and news rows.

entries.body: Availability ledger coverage and entries.
entries.formula: Entries require a player key, status, source id and verified_at; known/unknown counts are over the current squad; a provider injury boolean is not team news.
limitations: Curated team news; provenance checked, not recomputed.
entries.short: Availability ledger coverage and entries.

entries.body: Owner view, chairman frame, thesis and state.
entries.formula: Document envelope: owner view, chairman frame, thesis, claims and coverage state; opinion is attributed, measured counts are labelled.
limitations: Case claim; provenance checked, not independently recomputed.
entries.short: Owner view, chairman frame, thesis and state.

entries.body: The claim register: order, domain, status and counts.
entries.formula: One row per claim; count is the qualifying rows in the claim evidence table; status is supported, partial, can't test yet or not supported; order is editorial.
limitations: Case claim; provenance checked, not independently recomputed.
entries.short: The claim register: order, domain, status and counts.

entries.body: The evidence table attached to each claim.
entries.formula: One row per evidence item; count is the observed value, sample is the denominator or qualifying set; source and period are carried with the row.
limitations: Case claim; provenance checked, not independently recomputed.
entries.short: The evidence table attached to each claim.

entries.body: League performance of the other SPFL clubs.
entries.formula: League performance of the other SPFL clubs: best/worst/median position and points from the computed tables; current is the latest season position.
limitations: League performance only; other clubs transfer and wage models are not in the record.
entries.short: League performance of the other SPFL clubs.

entries.body: Availability, history and missing data classes.
entries.formula: Counts of known and unknown data classes; unknown is not zero and is listed in the coverage block.
limitations: Case claim; provenance checked, not independently recomputed.
entries.short: Availability, history and missing data classes.

entries.body: League record and kick-off shape churn.
entries.formula: played = competitive matches in the period; points = 3*won + drawn; gf/ga = league goals for/against; form = last five league results; churn = kick-off shape changes.
limitations: Case claim; provenance checked, not independently recomputed.
entries.short: League record and kick-off shape churn.

entries.body: Three-at-the-back record, wide roles and availability.
entries.formula: matches = matches with three centre-backs at kick-off; points_pg = points/matches; ga_pm = goals against/matches; wb_starts_pm = wing-back starts/matches; wf_starts_pm = wide-forward starts/matches; denominator = qualifying matches only.
limitations: Four three-CB matches; association only. Availability is unknown.
entries.short: Three-at-the-back record, wide roles and availability.

entries.body: Goals, shot share and the set-play/error gap.
entries.formula: gf/ga = league goals; shot_share = Aberdeen shots/(Aberdeen + opponent shots); attack_share = goals from wide forwards and strikers/total league goals; roles from the starting-XI grid.
limitations: No event data for set-piece goals, errors or penalties.
entries.short: Goals, shot share and the set-play/error gap.

entries.body: Manager phases, runs and the cup.
entries.formula: played/ppg by manager stint; winning_run/winless_run = longest league run; cup outcome from the honours register; interim spells are separate.
limitations: 18 Robinson matches; no pre-declared variance measure.
entries.short: Manager phases, runs and the cup.

entries.body: Arrivals, departures, age, U21 minutes and the Morris sale.
entries.formula: arrivals/departures = confirmed register rows in the window; median_age = median current squad age; u21_minutes_share = U21 minutes/total minutes; Morris sale = confirmed transfer.
limitations: Confirmed business only; fees are mostly undisclosed.
entries.short: Arrivals, departures, age, U21 minutes and the Morris sale.

entries.body: The Cormack-era record, managers, honours and transfers.
entries.formula: seasons = covered seasons; positions from computed league tables; honours from the register; manager_count = distinct people; europe from season documents.
limitations: The record cannot prove causation or boardroom intent.
entries.short: The Cormack-era record, managers, honours and transfers.

entries.body: One played-fixture document: score, summary, scoreboard, stats, fxG with model and goals ranges, timeline, lineups, player stats, performance, form and coverage.
entries.formula: One document per canonical played fixture; final score is authoritative; summary, timeline and scoreboard use regular goals only; missing classes are null with coverage labels; duplicate aliases are separate. The xg block carries fxG, an 80% model range, an 80% goals range, provider xG with its source, shots, penalties, xG per shot and the over/underperformance position.
limitations: The document family is checked for presence and source; the two ranges are checked for arithmetic and ordering, not independently recalibrated per page.
fxG is a team-match estimate, not provider xG, xGOT or a shot-level location model; provider xG is a different model and is never blended into it.
entries.short: One played-fixture document: score, summary, scoreboard, stats, fxG with model and goals ranges, timeline, lineups, player stats, performance, form and coverage.

entries.body: Current position and form, next fixtures, official and derived availability, measured aims, squad-decision lenses and the category bridges.
entries.formula: A projection of the current table row, the merged season schedule, the AFC availability ledger, sourced card rules, named-squad membership, matchday contenders, the season expectations and factual squad-decision lenses. No value, fee, wage, contract expiry or medical diagnosis is derived. Counts sum to the active universe (official list minus loanees out); the five official loan-outs are separate. Aims are analyst-set targets with a measured current value and status; they are not club targets.
limitations: Inferred absence is not a medical diagnosis; cause is not published.
Suspension rules are watch/review-only until the current SFA protocol is sourced.
No contract-expiry, free-agent, wage, fee or release-clause data is held.
Market/value language is not used; squad decisions are measured lenses only.
entries.short: Current position and form, next fixtures, official and derived availability, measured aims, squad-decision lenses and the category bridges.

entries.body: The fixture index: played results plus the remaining scheduled fixtures.
entries.formula: count = canonical played fixtures (duplicate aliases excluded); each played row carries score, result, depth and href. scheduled = remaining canonical fixtures after the played registry and conflict handling. scheduled_count = rows with status scheduled; scheduled_rows_total includes conflict_review rows; conflict_count = conflict_review rows. Conflict-review rows are retained but excluded from forward-looking surfaces.
limitations: Index rows are checked for presence; the fixture pages carry the detailed source coverage.
entries.short: The fixture index: played results plus the remaining scheduled fixtures.

entries.body: Team-match expected goals from open-play shot zones, shots on target, blocked shots and penalties; a model range, a goals range, provider-xG calibration, transfer check, provider-style estimate, manager splits, aggregates and coverage.
entries.formula: open_play_sot = max(0, shots_on_target - penalty_sot_subtracted); open_play_insidebox = max(0, shots_insidebox - penalty_attempts); fxG_open = a selected linear model on open-play inside-box, outside-box, shots on target, off-target and blocked counts; fxG = fxG_open + 0.76 * penalty_attempts. Coefficients are fitted by OLS to 2026-27 Premiership team rows where provider xG exists. The 80% model range is the 10th-90th percentile of match-clustered bootstrap predictions plus the leave-one-match-out residual pool. The 80% goals range is the convolution of a beta-binomial open-play distribution and a binomial penalty distribution. Aggregate variances are combined, never summed as intervals. provider_estimate = max(0, intercept + slope * fxg) for rows without provider xG; actual and estimated provider values are never summed. manager_splits sum league match rows by date-attributed manager stint, for and against separately.
limitations: fxG is a team-match estimate from shots, shot zones and penalties. It is not a location model, not xGOT and not provider xG. The record has no shot coordinates, distance, angle, body part, pressure or goalkeeper position.

The coefficients are calibrated to 2026-27 football-data provider xG. The gate is leave-one-match-out inside that season; the 2025-26 API-Football check crosses season and provider and is informational, not a clean holdout.
Penalties are priced at a fixed 0.76 xG and removed from open-play counts. Own goals, deflections and shootouts are outside the model.

The two ranges answer different questions. Neither is a confidence interval for team quality, a result prediction or proof of finishing skill. A discrete goals range can cover more than its nominal level.
The provider-style estimate is a separate calibration for rows without provider xG, not provider xG itself.
entries.short: Team-match expected goals from open-play shot zones, shots on target, blocked shots and penalties; a model range, a goals range, provider-xG calibration, transfer check, provider-style estimate, manager splits, aggregates and coverage.

entries.body: Expected goals divided by shots for a team match or aggregate.
entries.formula: fxg_per_shot = fxg / shots; null when shots is zero or unavailable.
limitations: Penalties are included in the numerator and denominator; the value is a descriptive scale, not a shot-level probability.
entries.short: Expected goals divided by shots for a team match or aggregate.

entries.body: Observed goals minus the team-match fxG estimate, with a shifted goals range.
entries.formula: goals_minus_fxg = goals - fxg. The shifted goals range is goals_low - fxg to goals_high - fxg.
limitations: One match or one season is not proof of finishing skill; overperformance usually regresses and style changes the chance profile.
entries.short: Observed goals minus the team-match fxG estimate, with a shifted goals range.

entries.body: The 80% range for the fxG estimate.
entries.formula: 10th-90th percentile of match-clustered bootstrap predictions plus a draw from the leave-one-match-out residual pool. Aggregates sum per draw; per-match ranges are never summed as intervals.
limitations: This is model uncertainty, not a result prediction or a confidence interval for team quality.
entries.short: The 80% range for the fxG estimate.

entries.body: The 80% range of goals from the same chances.
entries.formula: Convolution of a beta-binomial open-play goal distribution and a binomial penalty distribution; aggregate distributions are convolved across matches. The range is the 10th-90th percentile.
limitations: Shot quality is heterogeneous; the binomial approximation is conservative.
The range is not a prediction of the score and not a verdict on finishing.
entries.short: The 80% range of goals from the same chances.

entries.body: Measured shots, shots on target, off-target, blocked, inside-box, outside-box and penalty counts behind a team-match fxG value.
entries.formula: Counts are carried from the licensed team statistics and event feed; missing values are null, never zero.
limitations: Provider shot counts can disagree slightly across sources; the source row is named on the match page.
entries.short: Measured shots, shots on target, off-target, blocked, inside-box, outside-box and penalty counts behind a team-match fxG value.

entries.body: Cormack-era defeats by four or more goals, newest first.
entries.formula: goals_for/goals_against are the final score for each defeat with a margin of four or more; one row per fixture, newest first; the threshold is a display parameter, not a modelled value.
limitations: The four-goal threshold is a presentation choice; the match page carries the full score and record.
entries.short: Cormack-era defeats by four or more goals, newest first.

entries.body: One row per ranked player per league with provider season statistics, within-league role percentiles and profile scores.
entries.formula: Per-90 values are stat * 90 / minutes. Completed passes are passes_total * pass_accuracy / 100. Duel and dribble percentages divide by their provider attempts; conversion divides goals by shots; save percentage divides saves by saves + conceded. The rating percentile is the midrank percentile of the provider rating within the league and role family at 450+ minutes; the provider-group fallback is used only when the role cohort is below its minimum. Archetype scores are 100 * Phi(sum(w * shrunk robust z) / sum(abs(w))), with winsorisation at 1/99, median/MAD scaling, minutes shrinkage and weight renormalisation. The rose uses the same league-only rates: each axis is the midrank percentile of the raw value in the same role-family cohort (provider group fallback), with conceded_p90 ranked on negated values. Missing values and insufficient cohorts are null.
limitations: Provider ratings are opaque and relative to a league and role cohort; no cross-league ranking is published.
The feed has no xG/xA, progressive passes, carries, pressures, aerial wins or crosses, so those features are absent rather than inferred.
Role families need starting-XI grids; leagues without grids use the provider position group and say so.
Scouting priority is an Aberdeen preference, not a measured quality term.
The current club comes from the provider transfer feed; the stats club is kept where it differs. A subsequent move outside a pool team may be missing.
Rose percentiles are within the league and role cohort, not a cross-league rank. A missing or insufficient cohort is null, never zero.
entries.short: One row per ranked player per league with provider season statistics, within-league role percentiles and profile scores.

entries.body: Aberdeen role-family ratings against the Scottish Premiership cohort, with verified availability evidence.
entries.formula: The family average is the appearance-weighted mean provider rating of Aberdeen players at 300+ competitive minutes in the role family. The percentile is the midrank position of that average within the other Premiership players in the same role family at 450+ minutes; Aberdeen are excluded from their own cohort. The reading is structural below 40, at 40-60, above 60; a below-cohort family with one absent first-choice player is cover, two or more is hold. First-choice evidence is 10 starts or 900 minutes in the most recent prior season with at least 450 minutes.
limitations: The model cannot separate selection, availability and quality.
The provider rating is not a verdict; the cohort is the other Premiership players in the same role family, not a like-for-like cross-league pool.
Only verified official AFC team news can mark a player out or available.
entries.short: Aberdeen role-family ratings against the Scottish Premiership cohort, with verified availability evidence.

entries.body: Weighted player-profile scores, their feature weights, coverage, the attacker assist/goal split and the dedicated goal-scoring list.
entries.formula: Each archetype is a weighted composite of winsorised, robust z-scores within league and role family: z = (x - median) / (1.4826 * MAD), shrunk by minutes / (minutes + 450), combined with signed weights and mapped to 0-100 by the normal CDF. Missing features are removed and the remaining absolute weights renormalised; below 70% coverage the score is null. Weights are in config/scouting/archetypes.yaml and are published with the score.
limitations: A profile is not a position, a target or a recommendation.

Assist bias and goal bias are separate attacker profiles. Each leader list is ordered by its own adjusted profile score multiplied by the U23 and European preferences; the goal-scoring table is ordered by goals per 90, not by a composite.
The assist profile weights passes, key passes, pass accuracy and dribbles. The feed carries no crosses or chance-creation data, so those are absent rather than inferred.
The goal profile deliberately excludes pass and dribble volume so it does not reproduce the assist order.
entries.short: Weighted player-profile scores, their feature weights, coverage, the attacker assist/goal split and the dedicated goal-scoring list.

entries.body: Players outperforming teams that are underperforming in their league.
entries.formula: Team points per game = points / played in the provider's current league table. The team points percentile is the midrank percentile of that value among the league's teams. team_lift = player role-adjusted percentile - team points percentile. A team is underperforming when its percentile is at or below the configured maximum (default 40). The lens keeps players with a positive lift at those teams, ordered by lift then scouting priority. A league without a table is unknown, never zero-strength.
limitations: Team underperformance is a within-league points-per-game contrast, not a budget, wage or resource model.
A player's role-adjusted percentile and a team's points percentile are different units; the lift is a descriptive ranking aid, not a causal claim.
A league without a current table is unknown, not zero-strength.
entries.short: Players outperforming teams that are underperforming in their league.

entries.body: Aberdeen registered-squad position-specific per-90 output, competitive matches only.
entries.formula: The same per-90 and percentage formulas as scouting.pool, applied to the registered Aberdeen squad in competitive matches only (friendlies and loan-club rows excluded), at 180+ minutes. The rating is appearance-weighted; the percentile is within the Premiership role cohort. The rose uses Premiership-only rates against the same league and role cohort.
limitations: Forward and progressive passes, carries and pressures are not in the feed; they are unavailable, not inferred.
Loanees out are excluded; their loan-club rows are not Aberdeen output.
entries.short: Aberdeen registered-squad position-specific per-90 output, competitive matches only.

entries.body: Per-league provider coverage, role coverage and pool counts.
entries.formula: Counts of provider player-season rows, rated rows, rows at 450+ minutes, players with at least one starting-XI role, played fixtures and lineups fetched. Role coverage is role players divided by the league pool. Searchable requires at least 25 rated players.
limitations: Coverage is a provider fact at the last sync, not a permanent statement.
Scottish lower tiers have lineups but no player season statistics.
Current-club coverage comes from the team transfer feed and may miss a later move outside a pool team.
entries.short: Per-league provider coverage, role coverage and pool counts.

entries.body: The 0-100 scouting value index and the anchor-gated GBP value model.
entries.formula: Value index = 100 * sum(w_i * component_i) / sum(w_i) over performance (league-adjusted percentile / 100), age curve, minutes reliability (min(1, minutes / 1800)) and best adjusted profile score / 100. Weights are renormalised over available components and the index is null below 70% coverage. The GBP band is fitted only after the public-source anchor gate passes: log(value_gbp) = b0 + b1*adjusted_percentile/100 + b2*age + b3*age^2 + b4*log(minutes) + role-group dummies. The published band is the 80% prediction interval. No GBP value is published before the gate.
limitations: The value index is a scouting ordering, not a transfer value or fee.
The GBP band is not published until the public-source anchor register passes the gate; it is never an uncalibrated currency estimate.
Contract length, wages, release clauses and agent fees are unknown.
entries.short: The 0-100 scouting value index and the anchor-gated GBP value model.

entries.body: U23 and European shop-window weighting on top of the value index.
entries.formula: scouting_priority = value_index * age_multiplier * europe_multiplier. age_multiplier = u23_multiplier when age <= u23_max_age, else 1.0. europe_multiplier = europe_multiplier when european league-phase minutes >= europe_minutes_threshold, else 1.0. The European flag is built from the league-phase fixtures of the Champions League, Europa League and Conference League and the per-fixture player endpoint; qualifiers and play-offs are excluded. A player not found is none only when coverage is complete; otherwise the status is unknown and the multiplier is 1.0.
limitations: The U23 boost and the European shop-window discount are Aberdeen scouting preferences, not measured quality.
Only the league phase of the three UEFA competitions is used; qualifiers, play-offs and domestic Europe are not.
A player with fewer than 90 league-phase minutes is shown but not discounted. Unknown European status is not discounted.
Priority is not a transfer value or a fee.
entries.short: U23 and European shop-window weighting on top of the value index.

entries.body: Measured values come from a licensed source or an event reconstruction. Inferred values come from a model or a comparison. Curated values come from a public record or an editorial decision. Unknown means the public record does not support a value; it is not zero.
entries.short: How a value was produced.

entries.body: A coverage tier names the depth of the record behind a value, from event data through match data, curated facts and value-only inputs. A missing tier is labelled; it is never filled with a zero.
entries.short: How much of the relevant record is present.

entries.body: Unknown is a published state, not a zero or a guess. A missing injury, fee, contract term or provider field stays unknown until a public source supports it.
entries.short: The public record does not support a value.

entries.body: A role family groups starting-XI roles that do the same job, such as centre back, full back, centre midfield or centre forward. It comes from observed starting-XI grids where available; a generic position label is not promoted into a role.
entries.short: The grouping used to compare players with similar jobs.

entries.body: A percentile compares a player with a named cohort, usually the same league and role family. It is relative to that cohort and is not a cross-league ranking or a verdict.
entries.short: A player's position within a stated cohort.

entries.body: The adjusted percentile applies fitba's published league alignment to a within-league percentile. The adjustment, its basis and the coverage are visible; the value is still relative to the scouting universe, not a cross-league winner.
entries.short: A percentile after the published league adjustment.

entries.body: A cohort basis names the league, role family or provider group and the number of players in the comparison. A small cohort is labelled rather than hidden.
entries.short: The group and sample behind a percentile or rate.

entries.body: fxG is a descriptive model built from the licensed shot and match record. It is not provider xG, tracking data or a verdict on finishing. The model, its range and its evaluation gate are published; while the provider gate fails, fxG stays descriptive.
entries.short: fitba's expected-goals estimate from the available shot record.

entries.body: Provider xG is shown as its own source value, separate from fxG. It is not mixed into fitba's model or used as a verdict on the result.
entries.short: The licensed provider's expected-goals value.

entries.body: A provider rating is relative to the provider's own scale and league context. It is a selection input, not a fitba rating, a cross-league ranking or an individual verdict.
entries.short: The licensed provider's match rating.

entries.body: The value index combines the published scouting features into a relative index. It is not a GBP valuation, a transfer fee, a wage or a prediction of a future sale.
entries.short: A modelled index of scouting value, not a transfer fee.

entries.body: Scouting priority is a relative profile match within the scouting universe. It is not a target recommendation, a fee and not a claim that a player is available.
entries.short: How strongly a scouted profile matches Aberdeen's current role needs.
